title: Growing Black Holes in a Decaying Vacuum
content: In cosmological models with a time-varying cosmological constant, the stress-energy tensor of matter is not conserved due to coupling between matter and vacuum energy. This non-conservation leads to the possibility of an energy transfer from the vacuum energy to ordinary matter. It is therefore natural to expect that a dynamical vacuum energy can also affect the evolution of black holes. In this work, we investigate the evolution of black holes in such a background with a decaying vacuum. The black hole accretion rate is estimated for a simple model.
